title: PPG-MS23 — Sidecar Mutability Resolution + Architecture Hardening
description: Resolves the architecture contradictions surfaced by R01/R06 scrutiny. Introduces sidecar_overrides.json (machine-scoped, separately signed) so MS11 calibration deltas don't break MS0 SHA-locked canonical sidecar. Decomposes 38-stage pipeline into named-stage registry. Adds SidecarSchemaMigrator. Tags emit modes DETERMINISTIC vs ADAPTIVE.
rationale: Resolves the architecture contradictions surfaced by R01/R06 scrutiny. units.title: sidecar_overrides.json schema + separate Ed25519 signing
units.scope: Per-machine overrides with provenance; canonical sidecar stays inviolate; loader merges canonical+overrides with logged precedence; conflict resolution (LWW + supervisor-arbitrated CRDT).

units.title: PostProcessorPipelineEngine refactor: named-stage registry
units.scope: Replace 38 indexed stages with PipelineStageRegistry.register(name, fn, before/after); per-stage feature flags; stage-level latency histograms.

units.title: SidecarSchemaMigrator (v1→v2 dual-emit)
units.scope: Schema version negotiation handshake; N-1 backward read; deprecation TTL; dual-emit during transition.

units.title: DETERMINISTIC vs ADAPTIVE emit modes (idempotency)
units.scope: Tag emit modes; DETERMINISTIC freezes sidecar SHA + RAG snapshot for byte-diff regression CI; ADAPTIVE allows MS9/MS11 runtime data injection. MS12 byte-diff runs DETERMINISTIC.

units.title: Observability instrumentation (Prometheus/Grafana via prism_monitoring)
units.scope: Per-stage latency histograms, sidecar SHA mismatch counter, AGI-gate verdict distribution, MS11 telemetry freshness, circuit-breaker state. Wired to existing prism_monitoring dispatcher.

completion_criteria: sidecar_overrides.json resolves canonical-sidecar SHA conflict; machine-scoped + separately signed
Pipeline refactored to named-stage registry; index coupling eliminated; per-stage feature flags work
Schema migrator handles v1→v2 transition with dual-emit + deprecation TTL
DETERMINISTIC mode produces byte-identical output for byte-diff CI; ADAPTIVE allows runtime feedback
Observability instrumentation surfaces all critical metrics in prism_monitoring
